reason: Internal tooling / architecture change. No Jira ticket and no product-feature intake. Recorded to satisfy the change-package structure; provide a tracking key or accept as an internal ADR before approval.
summary: Integrate caraoke-workspace as the execution / worktree provider under the OpenSpec control plane
acceptance_criteria: A governed change can obtain a real, buildable worktree per affected repository from caraoke-workspace.
The pinned opsx runtime bundle is bootstrapped into a caraoke worktree with a pointer back to this control repo.
apply/verify run build and test through caraoke's run wrapper from inside the worktree.
The two repositories remain separate; caraoke is invoked only through existing public Makefile targets.
